## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) on Anne's thirteenth birthday, discussing growing up, school assignments, and romantic story plots. [Anne](../character/anne.md) proposes starting a story club to cultivate their imaginations, which eventually expands to include other classmates like Jane and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the story club's progress, defending their work and sharing her aspirations to be like Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to finish her household chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school term and travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. After weeks of anxious waiting, [Diana](../character/diana.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the published results to reveal that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne.md) shares the proud news with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before ending her night with a thankful prayer.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), though leaving [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) brings emotional farewells. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students adjust to their new environment and classes. In her boarding house room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels homesick until her schoolmates visit and share news about an upcoming Avery scholarship, sparking new academic ambitions.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After commencement, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), reunites with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and learns about Gilbert's plans and Matthew's declining health. She enjoys a peaceful day outdoors and has a tender evening conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) continue canvassing neighbors for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering an overly neat woman, odd locals, and an unhelpful household. Capitalizing on the birth of Lorenzo White's new son, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures a generous five-dollar donation after admiring the newborn. Later that night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) attempts to canvass Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute any money.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drops by while [Anne](../character/anne.md) is attempting to write, and they discuss their respective teaching experiences, students, and future career ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves to get a book, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her cousin Mary Keith is dying and needs someone to care for her twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) successfully persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the twins out of a sense of duty, agreeing to help with their sewing.
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> Suffering from a severe toothache, [Anne](../character/anne.md) has a disastrous and irritable day at school, accidentally throwing a package of fireworks into the stove and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. She returns home distraught over losing her temper, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next day, to Anne's surprise, Anthony shows newfound respect for her, which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) later confirms was earned through the whipping.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) plans a spring outing with [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and Jane to celebrate an adopted spring birthday. During their walk through the woods and pastures, the girls explore unknown paths, name a woodland pool, and discover [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's forgotten garden, where [Diana](../character/diana.md) tells the romantic story of Hester's life.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends discuss [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's life and imagine her appearance while visiting her old garden. They enjoy a picnic lunch by a brook, where [Anne](../character/anne.md) leads a poetic conversation about nature, poems, and the shapes of human souls. After a pleasant afternoon wandering the woods, the girls return home at sunset with fresh flowers.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne.md) will expose his corruption and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad deal to keep her quiet, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to make a deal and simply keeps the secret out of principle.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) expresses sadness about [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) clarifies that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is strictly a friend and describes her idealized view of love. The two girls discuss local gossip regarding [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong affection for each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> During an overnight stay, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) declines the offer, and Jane accepts the refusal coolly while noting that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects with a mixture of amusement and disappointment at how unromantic her very first marriage proposal turned out to be.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to go for a walk, but she must prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next afternoon, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to her again. [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts, and they share their mutual feelings and clarify past misunderstandings before walking home engaged.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time
